## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      7 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 27.06.2026 - 24.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Appfan69_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "Same bug after updating to IOS 27. Dev guys broke it again. Apparently the Dev guys do not read app reviews. I am done with exercise rings and Apple watch!!Relying on updates from Dev guys that probably don’t even wear the watch. Three version of Ultra watch now same bug and glitch!! There’s a serious bug with the Ultra watch. The exercise time “green number” does not update or get stuck randomly. Which is preventing me from closing my ring and possibly lose my streak. One time I did an extra 20 minutes and the exercise time did not reflect it. I had to reboot and even then I had to do another 10 minutes for the exercise time to update. I now have my exercise time set to 5 minutes just so I close my rings not lose my streak. Pretty serious bug for an expensive watch. Same bug even with latest software."
            2. _Dee Googs_, 24.09.2026, 2/5: "Don’t know what’s going on with the app lately but days that I’ve hit my move/calorie goal the next day I get a notification saying I didn’t hit my goal. I sync my data again and sometimes it will update and fix the issue but a lot times it won’t. This is very frustrating."
            3. _SarahCelebrian_, 02.09.2026, 2/5: "I got a Fastest 5k award for a 3.5km run and according to the award I ran the 5k in 20 minutes which doesn’t match the workout so no idea where it’s coming from. This is annoying because now I can’t see my actual fastest time or when it was. Very disappointing that there’s no easy way to report bugs like this. I’d expected better from Apple"
